stations.title: Fill cloudy juice
stations.does: Fill the sanitized empty glass bottle with cloudy apple juice through a nozzle.

stations.title: Screw cap red
stations.does: Screw on the red cap to the filled bottle.

stations.title: Apply paper label
stations.does: Apply the paper label to the capped bottle.

stations.title: Camera inspect + decide divert
stations.does: Use a camera to check fill level, cap presence/condition, and label placement.

stations.title: Single-lane reject diverter
stations.does: Reject any bad bottles by diverting them off the line at the inspection station (single-lane divert).

notes: Takt is 15 s/unit (240 units/hour). The station budgets (Fill 6 + Cap 3 + Label 2 + Inspect 4 + DivertRejects 1 = 16 s) must be adjusted to fit 15 s/unit.
To satisfy the food-grade constraint, all direct food-contact parts at Fill should be CIP/sanitary designed; the line assumes owner-supplied sanitized bottles on entry (no wash station included).
Inspect and reject must happen as a single-lane divert at ST4/ST5; set the vision decision latency so the diverter action occurs within the same bottle’s dwell time window.
